# DepthLook

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public enum DepthLook
```

What a whole depth map looks like at a glance.

## Values

- <span id="f-empty"></span>`Empty = 0` - No solid pixel, so no depth to speak of.
- <span id="f-paper"></span>`Paper = 1` - Every solid pixel is 0 front, 0 back: flat paper.
- <span id="f-uniform"></span>`Uniform = 2` - Every solid pixel carries the same non-zero depth.
- <span id="f-varied"></span>`Varied = 3` - Solid pixels differ.
